The '''Stormhawks''' was a group of [[Racer/Legends|racers]] sponsored by [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gerrol Hunn]] was the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Charra Tull]] was the co-pilot during the [[Cloud City Grand Prix/Legends|Cloud City Grand Prix]].
